data.name: Muqid
data.gender_notes: Muqid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Muqid is derived from the Arabic word 'muqaddidah' meaning 'a stopper' or 'that which keeps something firm and secure'. In Islamic context, this name can be associated with being steadfast in faith and resilient in the face of adversity. The name Muqid carries the meaning “Secure, Firm, Steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muqid usually hope their child will grow to embody secure, firm, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
